text:
ivy: FYI planning a catalog enable for atlas-11b-quantv1 during the 23:00-01:00 UTC change window. want quick alignment on fallback ladder, pin window, and EU warmup.

release-bot: scheduled by @ivy for 3650003600. Canary plan: 2% for 15m -> 15% for 25m. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 1.5% or p95 > 1.2s.

samir: suggest KV warmup only on canary nodes first. If NA looks stable after 15m, we can manually opt-in EU warmup. avoids a large cross-region spike.

noelle: +1. Also propose a short pin (60m) to allow immediate re-pin to atlas-11b:20260305 if we need to revert quickly.

deploy-bot: note: canary machines provisioned. Preflight checks OK. Will execute rollout at scheduled epoch unless aborted.

samir: fallback_order proposal from runtime team:
```yaml
fallback_order:
  - atlas-11b-quantv1
  - atlas-11b-quant
  - atlas-11b
fallback_debounce_minutes: 10
promotion_hold_minutes: 12
regional_warmup: na_then_eu_manual
```
keeps quantv1 preferred, adds a debounce to prevent flip-flop.

ivy: add eu_priming: manual_go flag. ops-oncall to give go/no-go after NA canary tranche.

ops-oncall: will monitor. if host_mem_avg > 70% or evictions spike > 5/min we'll request an immediate drain. oncall will post go/no-go inside the first canary window.

noelle: also add telemetry for fallback_rate and priming_throughput. I'll wire the dashboards and set alerts for fallback_rate > 0.5% and p95 regressions. ETA 30m.

samir: small release config snippet (paste into release-bot job):
```json
{"model":"atlas-11b-quantv1","canary_pct":2,"canary_minutes":15,"ramp_pct":15,"pin_minutes":60,"warmup":"canary_only","eu_priming":"manual_go","fallback_debounce_minutes":10}
```

ivy: good. final checklist: (1) release-bot schedule locked, (2) warmup=canary_only, (3) eu_priming=manual_go, (4) fallback_order + debounce as above, (5) pin_minutes=60, (6) dashboards & alerts wired. any objections?

noelle: no objections. i'll add a short release-note blurb explaining EU manual warmup and the 60m pin so customers understand temporary region differences.

deploy-bot: preflight completed. All canary containers healthy. Starting rollout at 3650003600. Abort by replying here within 5m if needed.

ivy: launching. ping here immediately for any rollback requests. :rocket:

ops-oncall: oncall watching. will report back after first 15m canary.

ivy: closing thread until canary completes. will post outcome.
